svg.title: How m2b works
svg.desc: How m2b works, from left to right, in three stories. 1, what goes in: in any Claude Code session you say remember that Dana's birthday is on 3 March; or you just work, and m2b proposes what you said in passing, a correction too, and you keep or drop it; or you give it a file. 2, m2b keeps it on your machine, as plain files in a folder you own, ~/m2b: the inbox; the curator, which files it at your next session start; memory/MEMORY.md, which starts every session; memory/lessons/, the corrections you kept; a file per subject; your words and files; and tasks/ or Apple Reminders. 3, what comes back: a later session in any project answers 3 March (dana.md); a lesson stops a command before it runs; a task is due on its day in the band.
